properties.site-address: Former Byrness County First School, Byrness
properties.notes: Former school site in a highly rural location that could offer potential for a small-scale residential development. The former school building remains in situ but the site may have potential for further residential development, but with an awareness of the rural context. A previous outline application for development of 6 dwellings lapsed without implementation (20061079, ENRP317).
